## Why

Open Dependabot PRs each fire metered Actions (and can trigger Vercel). Minutes are limited. Apply the **safe** bumps on one new branch, verify locally, open one draft PR. Leave the Dependabot PRs unmerged.

Security first. Quality seconds. Never Tailwind 4 in this PR.
